doc.name: A — smartphone case catalogue, desert rock, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: translucent MagSafe case
Category: smartphone case
Shot programme: desert rock
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are the art director signing off every frame of this smartphone case campaign. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the shadow-play silhouette in a desert rock treatment.

SUBJECT. A translucent MagSafe case. Product fidelity is non-negotiable: shape, seams, cap, closure, print placement and colour must match the reference precisely. Only the scene around it is yours to author.

CAMERA. Backlit so the product edge glows and the set falls into shadow. Shoot on a 35mm reportage at f/22, framing for a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control. Stage the product on or against cast pigmented resin, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
